name: Scientific Figure Copy-Detection Benchmark
description: First public release of the reproducible benchmark and code for the paper "Do Copy-Detection Descriptors Transfer to Scientific Figures? A Reproducible Benchmark for Full and Partial Figure Reuse" (CSAIDays 2026). Includes: Query-generation protocol over BioFors (full-copy and partial-copy regimes) Evaluation pipeline: pHash, DINOv2, SSCD, SSCD+Local (SIFT), SSCD+Tiling Hard partial-reuse study (varied area ratio, off-grid, cluttered) Results (CSV), figures, and ground truth Note: BioFors images are not redistributed here; they are downloaded from the original source (CC0). See README for full reproduction steps.
